stemMd: A volume is 2.5 cm³. What is it in cubic metres?
explanationMd: One centimetre is 10⁻² metres, so one cubic centimetre is (10⁻²)³ = 10⁻⁶ cubic metres. Multiply the volume by that factor to obtain 2.5 × 10⁻⁶ m³. Unit powers must be applied to conversion factors too.

distractorRationale.b: This applies the linear centimetre conversion to a volume.
distractorRationale.d: This squares rather than cubes the length conversion.
distractorRationale.e: This reverses the direction of conversion.
distractorRationale.a: This ignores the cubic scale factor.
